heading.en: When a couple cannot have a child

hook.en: Many couples cannot conceive even after two years of unprotected cohabitation. Science now offers them several ways to have a child.
hook.kn: ಎರಡು ವರ್ಷಗಳ ನಂತರವೂ ಅನೇಕ ದಂಪತಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಮಕ್ಕಳಾಗುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. ವಿಜ್ಞಾನ ಈಗ ಅನೇಕ ಪರಿಹಾರಗಳನ್ನು ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ.

body.en: *Infertility* may be physical, congenital, due to diseases, drugs, immunological or even psychological, and the problem may be in the male or the female. In in-vitro fertilisation followed by embryo transfer (IVF–ET, the 'test tube baby' programme), ova from the wife or a donor and sperm from the husband or a donor are fused in the laboratory. In ZIFT the zygote or early embryo with up to 8 blastomeres is transferred into the fallopian tube; in IUT an embryo with more than 8 blastomeres is transferred into the uterus.
body.kn: ಬಂಜೆತನಕ್ಕೆ ದೈಹಿಕ, ಜನ್ಮಜಾತ, ರೋಗ ಅಥವಾ ಮಾನಸಿಕ ಕಾರಣಗಳಿರಬಹುದು. IVF–ETಯಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರಯೋಗಾಲಯದಲ್ಲಿ ನಿಷೇಚನ ಮಾಡಿ ಭ್ರೂಣವನ್ನು ವರ್ಗಾಯಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ZIFTನಲ್ಲಿ 8 ಕೋಶಗಳವರೆಗಿನ ಭ್ರೂಣ ಅಂಡನಾಳಕ್ಕೆ, IUTನಲ್ಲಿ 8ಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಕೋಶಗಳ ಭ್ರೂಣ ಗರ್ಭಾಶಯಕ್ಕೆ.

say.en: ZIFT: up to 8 blastomeres gives fallopian tube.
IUT: more than 8 blastomeres gives uterus.
In IVF, ova and sperm are brought together in the laboratory; the zygote then grows into an early embryo.
An embryo of up to 8 blastomeres goes into the fallopian tube: ZIFT. One with more than 8 blastomeres goes into the uterus: IUT.
Other methods: GIFT puts a donor ovum into the fallopian tube; ICSI injects a sperm into the ovum; artificial insemination places semen in the vagina or uterus.
AI helps when the male cannot inseminate or has a very low sperm count. These methods need costly special centres; adoption is another option.
Board: assisted reproductive technologies.

explanation.en: ZIFT puts a zygote or early embryo (up to 8 blastomeres) into the fallopian tube; IUT puts an embryo with more than 8 blastomeres into the uterus. GIFT transfers a donor ovum into the fallopian tube. ICSI injects a sperm directly into an ovum. IUI places semen in the uterus.
explanation.kn: IVF-ET, ZIFT, IUT, GIFT, ICSI ಮತ್ತು IUI.

say.en: Match each assisted reproductive technology with its description.

body.en: In GIFT, an ovum collected from a donor is transferred into the fallopian tube of a female who cannot produce ova but can provide a suitable environment for fertilisation. In ICSI a sperm is injected directly into the ovum in the laboratory. When the male cannot inseminate or has a very low sperm count, artificial insemination (AI) introduces his or a donor's semen into the vagina or uterus (IUI, intra-uterine insemination). These methods need specialised, costly centres; adoption is another option.
body.kn: GIFTನಲ್ಲಿ ದಾನಿಯ ಅಂಡಾಣುವನ್ನು ಅಂಡನಾಳಕ್ಕೆ ವರ್ಗಾಯಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ICSIನಲ್ಲಿ ವೀರ್ಯಾಣುವನ್ನು ನೇರವಾಗಿ ಅಂಡಾಣುವಿಗೆ ಚುಚ್ಚಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ವೀರ್ಯಾಣು ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ ಕಡಿಮೆ ಇದ್ದರೆ ಕೃತಕ ವೀರ್ಯಸೇಚನ (AI/IUI).

problem.en: Choose the ART for each case: (a) a woman cannot produce ova but her oviducts are normal; (b) a man has a very low sperm count; (c) an embryo with 16 blastomeres is ready for transfer.

steps.en: (a) An ovum from a donor is placed in her fallopian tube: GIFT.
(b) His semen is collected and introduced into the uterus: artificial insemination (IUI); ICSI is another option.
(c) An embryo with more than 8 blastomeres goes into the uterus: IUT.
